lines.en: I walk with my head up and long strides.
My neck is held straight.
I cross the grass, pulling at it.

lines.zh: 我走在最前面，后面的跟着。
lines.en: I lead, and the others follow.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边发出低叫。
lines.en: I honk low as I walk.
If something blocks me, I go around.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人从后面靠近。
lines.en: I dislike being approached from behind.
I stop and swing my neck back to listen.
Nothing. I walk on.
I spread my wings and beat them twice.
Then fold them.
There is water on the ground. I walk through it.
It reaches my ankles.
I do not mind. I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我的叫声，能传过整片湖。
lines.en: My call carries across the whole lake.
A call comes back from afar.
I stand with my neck stretched long.

lines.zh: 鹅肉和鸭肉，能凑成一道菜。
lines.en: Goose and duck can make one dish.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我不确定是什么。
lines.en: Something is moving. I am not sure what.

lines.zh: 我的叫声，整片河岸都听见。
lines.en: My honk carries across the whole bank.
No one answers.
I lower my head for a few bites of grass.
The grass is rather old.
I swallow it anyway.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，喉咙动了一下。
lines.en: I raise my head and my throat moves.
The wind ruffles my feathers.
I shake my feathers out.
This meadow is wide.

lines.zh: 我喜欢能看见远处的地方。
lines.en: I like ground where I can see far.

lines.zh: 这样有东西来我早知道。
lines.en: Then I know when something comes.
I stand still, wings folded.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，脖子搭在背上。
lines.en: I settle down, neck draped over my back.
You come near and I raise my head.
My neck points at you, very long.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，把嘴对准你。
lines.en: Neck out, I point my bill at you.
A goose's neck stretched out is a warning.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，让自己看起来更大。
lines.en: I spread my wings to look bigger.
You come to a halt.
That will do.
I fold my wings back.
You move again.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，很短，草地都听见。
lines.en: I called once, brief; the meadow heard it.

lines.zh: 我叫起来，天上都听得见。
lines.en: When I call, they hear it in the sky.
You back off, so it is forgotten.

lines.zh: 我嘎了一声，翅膀半张着退。
lines.en: I honk and retreat, wings half-open.
My wings half open, guarding.
My chest feels tight.
I shake the dirt off me.
My feathers are disordered.
I preen twice.

lines.zh: 我的肉，能和鸭肉火鸡肉拼一盘。
lines.en: Goose, duck and turkey make one dish.

lines.zh: 我这身灰羽，护着身后的小雁。
lines.en: These grey feathers shield the goslings.

lines.zh: 痛归痛，这片岸还是我的。
lines.en: Pain or not, this bank is mine.
No one will drive me off.
That is grain.

lines.zh: 我走过去，脖子伸得很低。
lines.en: I walk over, neck low.
I peck it grain by grain.
The other geese come too.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀把它们挡开。
lines.en: I spread my wings to hold them off.
This is mine.
There is more in your hand. I see it.
I come one step closer.
If you do not give it, I will find my own.

lines.zh: 我护着地上的谷子，接着啄。
lines.en: Guarding the grain, I keep pecking.

lines.zh: 我咽下最后一口，盯着你的手。
lines.en: I swallow the last bite and stare at your hand.
Do you have more?
If not, go away.
I have grass to eat.

lines.zh: 我扭头走开，走几步又停下。
lines.en: I turn away, then stop after a few steps.
A few steps on, I look back.
You bump me and I honk.
I spread my wings and do not yield.
My neck stretches forward.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我的翅膀还张着。
lines.en: You back a step; my wings stay spread.
You stepped aside; I fold my wings.
Neck out, I honk loud.

lines.zh: 我的胸口被撞得有点闷。
lines.en: My chest feels bruised.
I stretch my neck out.
Neck up, I'm still right here.
Being shoved angers me.
That one has been nearby all along.
We call back and forth a few times.

lines.zh: 脖子一伸一低，节奏一样。
lines.en: Our necks rise and dip in the same rhythm.
We walk into the grass together.
There is a nest there, from last year.
I repair it.
She lowers herself.
I stand beside her.
If anything comes near, I call.
My call is loud.
I take it in my bill.
Not food. I throw it down.
I pin it with a webbed foot and peck at it.
Then lower my head to look.
This is of no use.
I release it.
It rolls into the grass.
I leave it alone.
There is more grain on the ground.
That one I want.

lines.zh: 芦苇那边有动静，我抬起头。
lines.en: Something stirs in the reeds; my head comes up.
I stretch my neck straight.
It is nearing my nest.
I spread my wings.
I give a loud honk.
But it will not halt.
I honk again, higher.
It comes to a halt.
But it will not leave.

lines.zh: 我低下头，脖子像一根棍。
lines.en: I lower my head, neck straight as a staff.

lines.zh: 我压低脖子，一步步压上去。
lines.en: Neck low, I press forward step by step.
Neck low, bill forward.
It loops; I loop with it.

lines.zh: 我一直挡在它和窝之间。
lines.en: I stay between it and the nest.
It goes left; I am there first.
I lower my neck and honk.
It glances back.
It begins to back away.
I follow.
I give it no chance to settle.
I bite its leg.
My wings beat against it.
I drive my chest into it.
It falls back a long way.
I chase and strike again.
That one was heavier.
It turns and runs.
I stop, chest heaving.
I fold my wings and shake off the dirt.
A few feathers are askew.
I come down on the grass.
My wings raise a puff of dust.
I stand and stretch my neck.
The grass here is decent.
There is water, and open ground.
There are a few others far off.
They have seen me.
I land calling, summoning the flock.
They answer me.
I walk toward them.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翅膀，我扑打着跑开。
lines.en: Fire catches my wing; I beat it and run.

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下来，重重落在草地上。
lines.en: I fall from the air and hit the grass hard.
Water covers me; I thrash my wings.

lines.zh: 炸风把我掀进泥里，翅膀压住。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the mud, wings pinned.

lines.zh: 我昂着头走在最前，后面的跟着。
lines.en: Head high, I lead and the rest follow.

lines.zh: 光把我箍住，翅膀张不开。
lines.en: Light binds me and my wings will not open.

lines.zh: 草都吃完了，我的叫声也弱了。
lines.en: The grass is eaten out and my call has gone weak.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我的翅膀僵住了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my wings lock.

lines.zh: 地面没了，我在黑里扑翅。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I beat my wings in black.
